text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"They are...
They aren't...
They are......
They aren't......"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Make Debut. While many Umamusume trembled
with nervous anticipation, Manhattan Cafe's
mind was somewhere else entirely.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, before the race...
May I... go look around... for a little bit?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (...Not here, not here, not here, no...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's... there was someone...
Far beyond the goalpost...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They looked so happy. So I knew
I wasn't wrong after all. That's why...
choice_data_list: Let's try to catch up, even just a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The secret game of tag that had continued unbeknownst to anyone
—finally unfolds upon the turf.
